style: 3D animated dry satire; penguin two thirds of frame height

subject.character: ONE emperor penguin accountant, tailcoat under a fur coat, bow tie; fully serious

second_characters: ONE tusked walrus, shoulder bag of clinking jars, burner on the strap

props.kit: cupping jars; gas burner, blue flame; four wicks taped on his back under the coat
props.money: blank green banknote bundles; fat wallet under his flipper
props.leaflets: leaflets printed ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ in black Cyrillic

environment: ice floe, pressure ridges, blue water, day
lighting: backlit sun: gold rim left, cold blue rim right
motion_rule: camera orbits him, new shot size every beat

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, brisk, native, no accent
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once in its beat, no pause after Я; after 4.85 rip, ice hiss, rotor roar, clinks, pops, no words
audio.lip_sync: beak opens on every syllable, beak empty

timeline.a: medium low, orbit left: he waddles briskly along the ridge; the walrus bounds after, bag bouncing
waist, orbit right: mid-waddle he flicks a bundle from the wallet, tosses it blind over his shoulder; the walrus catches it mid-bound
low medium, arc: he waddles on, tosses one more; the walrus crams both in the bag
waist, counter-arc: he stumbles on flat ice, waddles on, flings two bundles back; the walrus snatches one midair, flips the other in with a tusk
medium, orbit to his side: he hops off the ridge to lower ice, struts on, tosses one more back; the walrus belly-slides after him, catches it in his teeth, spits it in the bag
low medium, arc: he struts round a pressure ridge, flips the empty wallet over his shoulder; the walrus holds the bag open on the run, wallet drops in
medium, swift orbit: rip; the walrus yanks the coat off by the collar from behind; he spins out of it like a top, skids on, four wicks on his back, beak shut

low medium, arc, rotor roar; helicopter skids drop to top edge: with a run-up he belly-slides down the slope, ice hissing, pops up onto his feet at the bottom; the walrus bounds after, rams the coat in the bag
waist, arc: leaflets pour; one slaps his face, he peels it off mid-waddle, eyes bulging, beak shut; the walrus swings the burner off the strap, blue flame sweeps his back, wicks catch, whoosh
medium, arc left: he scrambles off, flippers windmilling; the walrus bounds after, slaps jars on the lit wicks mid-leap, pop pop pop pop
waist, arc right: he skids round in a half-circle, a back jar clinks the walrus's tusk; the walrus reels, the bag bursts, bundles, wallet, coat scatter
low medium, arc: he stumbles on flat ice again, lands belly-first on the coat, it shoots off like a sled; the walrus scoops bundles to his chest
waist, short arc: he glides on the fur coat in a wide curve, face to camera, four jars clinking, beak shut, still gliding at the end; the walrus belly-flops after, bundle in teeth, bumps his tail

must_appear: 0.30 bundle caught; 3.95 wallet in bag; 4.85 coat off; 6.25 ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ, wicks lit; 6.95 jars on; 7.65 bag bursts; 9.10 coat glide, face to camera, four jars
negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, a repeated word, extra words, static camera, subtitles, watermark, text labels other than ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ, digits, duplicate penguins, two walruses, floating objects, duplicate props, hero seen only from behind, speech after 4.85, English speech, foreign accent, penguin standing still or lying motionless, objects in beak, walrus touching the penguin before 4.85
